title: Els determinants
author: Jordi Marcó i Ruiz
school: Escola Sant Martí Arenys de Munt (Maresme)

description.en:
This project of activities is aimed to first-year students of primary education, with the aim of strengthening the basic operations of addition and subtraction through memory games, puzzles, written responses and associations. Project of activities about the determinants:
  • articles
  • demonstration
  • possessive
  • numerals (cardinal and ordinal)

  • possessius
  • numerals (cardinals i ordinals)
